about.title: About
about.description: Backend Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing and building scalable cloud-native systems using ASP.NET Core, Azure Functions, and Java. Specialized in REST API design, authentication systems (JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC), payment integrations (Stripe, App Store, Google Play), and PostgreSQL database architecture. Currently at The Bubble Hub, leading backend development across two products serving thousands of monthly active users.

intro.paragraph1: I'm a backend engineer specialized in building cloud systems with Azure and .NET. My work focuses on creating architectures that scale, APIs that perform under load, and code that remains maintainable over time. I primarily work with Azure Functions, ASP.NET Core, and cloud services, designing solutions that balance performance, maintainability, and operational cost.
intro.paragraph2: At The Bubble Hub I work on backend systems that support mobile applications in production. My responsibility spans from analyzing requirements to designing and implementing business logic, defining API contracts, and integrating with external services. I solve problems ranging from optimizing ranking algorithms and data structures to designing secure authentication flows and managing Apple and Google subscription systems that directly impact user experience. I've developed serverless functions, designed optimized database schemas, and built CI/CD pipelines. This exposure to production systems has taught me to think in terms of scalability from design and to consider the impact of each technical decision. I've evolved from writing code that works to designing systems that scale, from solving individual problems to thinking about complete architectures.
intro.paragraph3: Before this, at Ernst & Young I worked in the SOC as a technology and security consultant, specialized in SIEM engineering. There I learned to think about large-scale systems from the perspective of observability, reliability, and security. I led SIEM platform migrations and developed detection rules that processed millions of daily events. This experience gave me a deep understanding of how distributed systems work under real load and how to design robust data pipelines. I learned that observability is not optional: when a system processes millions of events, you need metrics, logs, and traces to understand what's happening. This security experience gave me a mindset I constantly apply: thinking about how a system can fail, how it can be attacked, and how it can degrade gracefully. This perspective has been fundamental in my evolution as a backend engineer.
intro.paragraph4: My Software Engineering degree provided me with a solid foundation in computing fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system design. This theoretical foundation applies constantly: when I optimize algorithms, I apply computational complexity knowledge; when I design data structures, I understand the implications of each choice; when I make architectural decisions, I have foundations to evaluate trade-offs. During my studies I developed real projects, such as a web platform for smart meter management, which taught me to translate real-world requirements into software architectures and to think about complete systems, not just code. I am currently pursuing a Master's in Artificial Intelligence at UNIR, with the goal of integrating ML and AI techniques into backend system design: from data pipelines to APIs that serve models in production. My approach to learning is continuous: I study systems in production, experiment with new approaches, and seek to understand not just how to do something, but why one solution is better than another in a given context.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis
legalBasis.content: The processing of your personal data is based on your explicit consent, which you grant by checking the acceptance box in the contact form before submitting it.

content.important: This website does not store any personal data from users. The data is used solely to send me an email notification and is not retained by any third-party processor.
content.paragraph2: This website is hosted on Vercel (Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, United States), which acts as a data processor for hosting and delivering the website. Vercel may collect automatic technical data (IP address, server logs) necessary for the service operation.
content.paragraph3: You can review our processors' privacy policies:

content.paragraph1: This website does not store personal data on its servers. Data sent through the form is delivered to me via email through Resend and is not retained by any third-party processor beyond what is necessary for delivery.
content.paragraph2: Data will be retained only for the time necessary to respond to your inquiry. Once the communication is concluded, data will be deleted within a maximum period of 2 years, unless there is a legal obligation requiring longer retention.
content.paragraph3: The technical cookie used for rate limiting automatically expires after 24 hours. Data stored in localStorage (used as a backup for the cookie) is deleted when the user clears their browser's local storage.

content.intro: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:

rights.access: Access your personal data and obtain information about its processing
rights.erasure: Request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten)
rights.objection: Object to the processing of your data
rights.portability: Request portability of your data in a structured format
rights.restriction: Request restriction of processing of your data
rights.withdraw: Withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing
rights.automated: Not be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing

content.contact: To exercise these rights, you can contact me at: contact@jjalcantara.dev
content.responseTime: I commit to responding to your request within a maximum period of one month from receipt. If the request is complex or there are multiple requests, this period may be extended to two months, with notification to you.
content.complaint: If you believe that the processing of your personal data violates the GDPR, you have the right to file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) at www.aepd.es or with the supervisory authority in your country of residence.

content.paragraph1: This website uses two essential technical cookies and localStorage for its proper functioning.
content.cookiePurpose: Stores only a timestamp of the last form submission to limit submissions to 3 per hour.
content.cookieType: Essential technical — does not require consent under GDPR
content.cookie2Purpose: Stores the language selected by the user (es / en) so the site always displays in the chosen language without redirecting based on browser settings.
content.cookie2Type: Essential technical — does not require consent under GDPR
content.localStoragePurpose: Used as a backup for the rate limiting cookie to ensure its functionality even if cookies are disabled. Stores only a timestamp and is deleted when the user clears their browser's local storage.
content.noTracking: No tracking, advertising, or analytics cookies are used. No information is shared with third parties.
content.paragraph6: You can configure your browser to reject cookies or clear local storage at any time, although this may affect the contact form functionality and language preference.

content.paragraph1: I implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, destruction, or alteration. These measures include:

measures.encryption: Encryption of data in transit via HTTPS/TLS
measures.headers: Security headers configured (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
measures.validation: Validation and sanitization of all input data
measures.access: Restricted access to data only for authorized purposes

content.paragraph2: Despite these measures, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. I cannot guarantee absolute security of data, but I commit to notifying you of any security breach that may affect your personal data.

content.paragraph1: Contact form data is delivered via Resend, which has servers in the United States. Website hosting is provided through Vercel, also with servers in the United States.
content.paragraph2: These transfers are made under the appropriate safeguards established in the GDPR:

guarantees.clauses: Standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission

content.paragraph3: Resend and Vercel have implemented technical and organizational measures to ensure that your personal data receives an adequate level of protection equivalent to that established in the GDPR.

minors.title: 11. Protection of Minors
minors.content: This website is not directed to minors under 16 years of age. We do not intentionally collect personal data from minors under 16 without parental or legal guardian consent. If you are aware that a minor has provided personal data through this website, please contact me immediately at contact@jjalcantara.dev so I can delete such information.

content.paragraph1: If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA):

rights.know: Right to know what personal data is collected, used, shared, or sold
rights.delete: Right to request deletion of your personal data
rights.optOut: Right to opt-out of the sale of your personal data (we do not sell data)
rights.nonDiscrimination: Right to not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights

content.paragraph2: To exercise these rights, you can contact me at contact@jjalcantara.dev. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.

content.paragraph1: I reserve the right to update this privacy policy when necessary to reflect changes in data processing practices, legal requirements, or website improvements.
content.paragraph2: Any material changes will be notified by updating the "Last updated" date at the beginning of this document. It is recommended to periodically review this policy to stay informed about how we protect your data.
content.paragraph3: If changes are substantial, you will be notified through a prominent notice on the website or by email if possible.
